turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve had letdowns before, it’s totally normal to be extra careful about what you buy next.

A few things about our quality that might help:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants grown at our nurseries in Oregon (we don’t buy from outside growers).
They’re true to variety, virus-free, and shipped in 1-gallon containers with soil, defoliated so they travel well and can settle in quickly.
We stand behind them with a one-year guarantee on roses, plus hands-on support from our garden advisors.

From here, I’d love to narrow things down so we pick the best fit on the first try:

What are you looking for right now: a rose, a perennial, or fall bulbs?
Do you know your hardiness zone, or your city/state?
Anything that matters most to you: strong fragrance, repeat blooming, disease resistance, specific color, climbing vs bush, or container-friendly?

If you answer those, I can point you to only the top-quality options that match exactly what you need, rather than you having to sort through everything yourself.
